About HeyGermany

Germany urgently needs international talent. Yet complex and lengthy recognition processes prevent many qualified professionals from working in the jobs they trained for. At the same time, employers struggle to fill critical positions.

HeyGermany wants to change that. We are building the digital infrastructure to make professional recognition and work integration faster and easier. We are starting with nursing and plan to expand into other regulated professions. Our mission is to remove bureaucratic barriers and help international talent access jobs that match their qualifications.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on, product-minded Founding CTO with the ambition to build HeyGermany as a co-founder. You will take ownership of our technology and play a leading role in product development. You will work closely with the Founder & CEO on company strategy, product direction and execution. We already have a live MVP (www.hey-germany.com), an initial recognition engine and talent pool, 400+ talent pool conversions, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding. Your challenge will be to turn this foundation into a scalable technology platform that can take HeyGermany from one profession to many.

What You’ll Do

- Own our technology strategy and architecture and help shape our product strategy and roadmap.
- Design and build scalable systems for qualification recognition, document processing, workflow automation and talent matching.
- Turn complex regulatory and bureaucratic processes into simple, intuitive digital products.
- Stay hands-on across the stack and make key decisions across frontend, backend, APIs, data and cloud infrastructure.
- Develop our AI capabilities where they create real value, particularly in document analysis, structured data extraction and workflow automation.
- Work directly with users, employers and domain experts. As we grow, you will build and lead HeyGermany’s product and engineering team.

What We’re Looking For

- We care less about your current title than about what you have built and the level of ownership you are ready to take.
- 7+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong hands-on development skills.
- A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software
- Engineering or a closely related technical discipline. A Master’s degree is preferred.
- A proven track record of shipping a real product end-to-end in a leading technical role, for example as a founder, founding engineer, startup CTO or technical lead.
- Strong experience with a modern web stack, ideally TypeScript, React/Next.js, backend development, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.
- Practical experience building with LLMs and modern AI systems, including RAG, agents and evaluations, and using AI effectively in your day-to-day work.
- Strong product judgment and the ability to turn customer and business problems into pragmatic product and technical decisions.
- The ability to move fast in an early-stage environment and make good trade-offs between speed, quality and scalability.
- A founder mindset and strong connection to our mission. You want real ownership, are comfortable with the ambiguity of a pre-seed company and care about the business beyond technology.
- Strong English communication skills are required. German is a plus.
- Experience with document intelligence/OCR, B2B SaaS, marketplaces, HR Tech, Global
- Mobility or regulated/GDPR-sensitive products is valuable, but not required.

What We Offer

- €50,000–€65,000 annual base salary, depending on experience, plus meaningful equity reflecting the founder-level ownership of the role.
- The opportunity to become a true co-founder, with long-term ownership of technology and meaningful participation in the company’s upside.
- Founder-level influence over product, technology and company strategy, with the opportunity to build our architecture and future engineering organisation from the ground up.
- A live product, early traction, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding. We are currently in conversations with investors for our next stage of growth.
- The opportunity to work on a problem with tangible social and economic impact: helping international professionals access jobs that match their qualifications while helping employers access talent they urgently need.

We believe professional opportunities should be determined by people’s skills, not by their ability to navigate bureaucracy. If this is a company you would like to help build, we would like to hear from you.

Send one thing you've built that you're proud of, and tell us why this mission matters to you.

katharina@hey-germany.com

For our growing team, we are looking for an experienced Sovereign Cloud / Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to support the secure, reliable, and continuous operation of modern cloud-native and Kubernetes platforms.

You will work with an experienced DevOps/SRE team on highly secure, business-critical platforms, taking responsibility for platform operations, automation, monitoring, incident management, security, and continuous improvement.

The role focuses particularly on Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, logging, and operational excellence within a highly available Unified Observability Platform in a 24x7 operational environment.

Mandatory Requirements – Please Read Before Applying

Citizenship

You must hold valid citizenship in a country that is a full member of both the European Union (EU) and NATO.

If you hold multiple citizenships, all citizenships must be from countries that are members of both the EU and NATO.

Employment in Germany

You must:

- Be employed directly by a legal entity registered in Germany.
- Hold a German employment contract.
- Be subject exclusively to German labor law.
- Comply with all applicable German tax, social-security, and employment regulations.
- Reside in Germany.

Employment through non-German entities, including foreign subcontractors or affiliates, does not meet this requirement.

Security Clearance – Ü2

You must hold a valid and verifiable Ü2 security clearance in accordance with the German Security Clearance Act (Sicherheitsüberprüfungsgesetz – SÜG) and applicable preventive personnel sabotage-protection requirements.

Tasks

Kubernetes & Platform Operations

- Operate and maintain Kubernetes clusters with Gardener, including workloads, deployments, Helm charts and platform components.
- Troubleshoot availability, performance and deployment issues.
- Ensure secure, scalable, resilient and highly available platforms.

CI/CD & Automation

- Operate and optimize Jenkins and ArgoCD pipelines for automated deployments.
- Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Git-based deployment workflows.
- Develop automation and operational tools using Python, Go and/or Bash.
- Automate provisioning, health and compliance checks, alerting and reporting.

Monitoring & Observability

- Manage Prometheus, Thanos and OpenTelemetry environments, including scrape jobs, alert rules and PromQL.
- Develop and maintain Grafana dashboards.
- Continuously improve monitoring and alerting capabilities.

Logging & Log Management

- Operate and optimize Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Logstash and Kibana.
- Monitor log ingestion, storage, performance and reliability.
- Support centralized troubleshooting, anomaly detection, security and compliance.

Integration & Operations

- Integrate observability and logging platforms with ServiceNow, PagerDuty and other enterprise tools via secure APIs.
- Handle operational requests.
- Participate in Scrum, DevOps and service-improvement activities.
- Collaborate with internal teams, SAP, suppliers and stakeholders.

Incident & Problem Management

- Participate in a 24/7 on-call and shift rotation, including weekends and public holidays.
- Respond to platform, monitoring, logging and deployment incidents.
- Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
- Support Major Incident Management (MIM).
- Implement sustainable corrective actions.
- Continuously improve platform stability, resilience and operational processes.

Requirements

Key Technologies

Kubernetes | Gardener | Helm | Jenkins | ArgoCD | Git | IaC | Python | Go | Bash | Prometheus | PromQL | Thanos | OpenTelemetry | Grafana | Elasticsearch | OpenSearch | Logstash | Kibana | ServiceNow | PagerDuty | REST APIs

Technical Skills & Experience

- Proven experience as a Sovereign Cloud Engineer and/or Site Reliability Engineer (SRE).
- Strong experience operating and maintaining Kubernetes clusters, ideally with Gardener.
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes workloads, deployments, Helm charts and platform components.
- Experience troubleshooting availability, performance and deployment issues.
- Experience with Jenkins and ArgoCD for automated CI/CD deployments.
- Solid understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Git-based deployment workflows.
- Programming or scripting experience with Python, Go and/or Bash.
- Experience with automation of provisioning, health checks, compliance checks, alerting and reporting.
- Hands-on experience with Prometheus, PromQL, Thanos and OpenTelemetry.
- Experience developing and maintaining Grafana dashboards and monitoring/alerting solutions.
- Experience with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Logstash and Kibana.
- Understanding of log ingestion, storage, performance and reliability.
- Experience supporting centralized troubleshooting, anomaly detection, security and compliance.
- Experience integrating platforms with ServiceNow, PagerDuty and other enterprise tools via secure REST APIs.
- Experience with incident management, Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Major Incident Management (MIM).
- Experience working in 24/7 operational environments, including on-call and shift rotations.
- Strong understanding of platform security, scalability, resilience, reliability and high availability.
- Experience working in Scrum and DevOps environments.
- Strong collaboration skills and experience working with internal teams, SAP, suppliers and other stakeholders.

Languages

- English: Required
- German: A plus

Benefits

What You Can Expect

- A technically challenging role within a highly secure and business-critical cloud environment.
- The opportunity to work with modern cloud-native, Kubernetes and observability technologies.
- An international working environment with teams and stakeholders across different locations.
- The opportunity to contribute to automation, platform reliability and continuous improvement.

jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Help shape the future of siRNA therapeutics by translating cutting-edge DMPK science into impactful drug discovery strategies. In your new role, you will provide scientific leadership, work within multidisciplinary project teams, and influence key decisions from lead optimization to clinical translation. Join us to advance innovative research and accelerate the translation of siRNA therapies from discovery to patients.
This position can be filled either as Principal Scientist or Senior Principal Scientist.
Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.com
Tasks & responsibilities

- As a recognized scientific expert in DMPK for siRNA therapeutics, you will provide scientific guidance and innovative solutions to pharmacokinetic and tissue disposition challenges across discovery research programs.
- Furthermore, you will contribute to multiple multidisciplinary project teams by lead optimization, candidate selection, and translational strategies, thereby driving the success of siRNA-based drug discovery programs.
- You will define and advance screening strategies with a focus on in vitro ADME, in vivo PK, and PK/PD to deepen the understanding of siRNA disposition, tissue targeting, efficacy, and safety, as well as coordinate DDS activities.
- In research teams and stakeholder meetings, you will interpret, communicate, and influence DMPK strategies and key project decisions through scientific expertise.
- The role will include the supervision of in vivo pharmacokinetic studies and the planning and coordination of relevant DMPK profiling activities.
- Moreover, you will contribute to the development and application of innovative experimental and data analysis approaches to advance siRNA and oligonucleotide research.

Additional tasks for the Senior Principal Scientist role:

- You will shape our siRNA strategy within the company while mentoring scientists and defining scientific best practices.
- In addition, you will develop and implement new strategies in international projects and initiatives to continuously improve workflows and interfaces and represent the company's delivery science externally in scientific networks, conferences and partnering discussions.

Requirements

- PhD (or equivalent) in pharmacokinetics, drug metabolism, pharmacology, biology, pharmaceutical sciences, or related discipline
- In-depth knowledge of DMPK, phys.-chem. profiling and formulation principles and proven track record in siRNA therapeutics
- Several years of pharmaceutical industry experience in drug discovery of siRNA, with demonstrated success in translating preclinical findings into clinical development
- Proven experience in the design, interpretation and ideally also supervision of in vivo PK studies of siRNA therapeutics
- Excellent overview of scientific literature in the siRNA field as well as an already established scientific network
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in international cross-functional teams and convey complex scientific concepts to diverse stakeholders

Additional requirements for the Senior Principal Scientist role:

- Longterm professional experience within the pharmaceutical industry, including leadership of complex, cross-functional drug discovery projects and platform initiatives, and communication to senior leadership forum
- Recognized scientific standing in the siRNA community, demonstrated by publications, patents, invited talks or successful external collaborations

What you'll build

As a Government Security (Senior) Risk Specialist (f/m/d) for Government Security (GS2) you will closely collaborate with all functions at SAP contributing to internal programs enabling SAP’s success in Public Sector and Restricted Industries markets. Your responsibilities include:

- Run and mature programs to monitor adherence to national security regulations which may impact SAP directly or indirectly through its engagements with customers and partners in the Sovereign Cloud environment
- Run analysis and report KPI’s that demonstrates SAP’s path of improvement to fulfil national security regulations in the US and abroad when delivering Sovereign Cloud capabilities
- Contribute to the National Security Governance risk management scheme with dedicated German focused risk reporting out of SAP SE on Sovereign Cloud
- Advise SAP employees in Sovereign Cloud and supporting fields at SAP in Germany on questions regarding national security protection measures
- Oversee the compliant administration, secure registry management, and legally sound handling of restricted materials and sensitive official data within the department
- Continuously collaborate with other corporate functions at SAP to ensure cross-border collaboration of SAP employees for SAP’s Sovereign Cloud customers in public sector and restricted industries
- Be advocate in SAP SE to strengthen understanding and posture of SAP National Security Services Inc. with all other SAP affiliates in Germany

What you bring

- Apprenticeship or Bachelor’s degree in Security Management, Criminal Justice, Political Science, or related field
- 5 years + Prior experience or strong familiarity with strict regulatory frameworks regarding the tracking, filing, and processing of sensitive documents and restricted information
- Business Experience in cooperation with public institutions and authorities is a plus
- Excellent communication and liaison skills
- Excellent German language skills both in written and spoken language; English skills both in written and spoken language
- Regular mandatory on-call duty for night-time and weekend coverage required
- Residing in Walldorf or (direct) surroundings
- Willingness to go through personal security clearance (Government process)

Where you belong

SAP Government Security and Secrecy (GS2) organization is part of the SAP Customer Services and Delivery Board Area. This organization ensures strict liability fulfillment of customers’ national security requirements, business enablement in sensitive industries and compliance with Critical Infrastructure as well as Telecommunication regulations for SAP world-wide.
